description:
YITAMOTOR Towing mirrors perfectly fit for 1999-2002 Chevy Silverado GMC Sierra 1500 2500 3500, to replace the factory mirrors. They make perfect replacements with great upgrades that have good cost savings over the dealer parts.
Fitment
1999-2002 Chevy Silverado GMC Sierra 1500 2500
2001-2002 Chevy Silverado GMC Sierra 1500HD 2500HD 3500
2000-2002 Chevy Suburban 1500 Suburban 2500
2000-2000 Chevy Tahoe (excluding Z71 Models)
2001-2002 Chevy Tahoe GMC Yukon Yukon XL Denali
2002-2002 Chevy Avalanche 1500 2500
2000-2000 GMC Yukon (excluding Denali Models)
2000-2002 GMC Yukon XL 1500 2500
Professional installation would be highly recommended
Features
Vehicle Compatibility: Fits 02 Chevy Avalanche 1500 2500, 99 - 02 Chevy Silverado GMC Sierra 1500 2500, 01 - 02 Chevy Silverado GMC Sierra 1500 HD 2500 HD 3500, 00 - 02 Chevy Suburban GMC Yukon XL 1500 2500, 01 - 02 Chevy Tahoe GMC Yukon Yukon XL Denali, 00 Chevy Tahoe (excluding Z71 Models), 00 GMC Yukon (excluding Denali Models)
Advanced Power Heated Technology: Instantly eliminates frost, fog, and ice in rain, snow, or cold weather with heated tow side mirrors, providing crystal-clear visibility and safer driving conditions during harsh climates
Dual-Glass Telescoping & Fold Design: Features a power-adjusted flat mirror paired with a manual convex mirror for adjustable views; the telescoping system extends for wider trailer coverage and folds compactly for easy storage and parking
Precision Fit & Easy Installation: Engineered for exact bolt-on replacement with no modifications, these black towing mirrors install quickly and securely; includes a complete LH (driver) and RH (passenger) pair set for immediate use
Professional Installation Recommended: For optimal performance, disable memory functions via D.I.C. on equipped vehicles and consult a professional installer if your truck lacks turn signals to maximize durability and functionality

specifications.Material: Aluminum base; ABS plastic shell case
